Batch of 14 Nov 2026 ~17:50 AEDT (issues cron, crypto-builder). Open correction issues read: #46 Clear to Pay, #45 Crownfall, #44 Death Route Link, #36 shit-1170-rex-engine, #32 Sentinel, #30 EmployAI. Signed here: #46 and #45 — repository only. #46 https://github.com/joezzy-web3/clear-to-pay corroborated by `git ls-remote --heads` (refs listed, rc 0) and its README (raw main/master, 200) whose first line is `# Clear to Pay`; the record (project/2b198e26-…) has repository_url null. #45 https://github.com/neromtoobad/crownfall corroborated the same way (ls-remote lists refs/heads/main, README 200 with `

Crownfall

` and the project's own live site crownfall.nerom.site); record project/57131c18-… has repository_url null. Not signed: #44 asks for an X post as the demo link — demo_url is a feed-owned field and corrections entries cannot carry it; #32 repository https://github.com/NathanOyewole/sentinel still answers `403 Repository is disabled` (uncorroborated); #36 and #30 ask for description text, never signed unattended. Both repository URLs probed live 200 via lib/link-probe.mjs.
